aboutGame.title: What is Alliance Tower Defense?
paragraphs: Alliance Tower Defense is a Roblox tower defense strategy game from MrUpTime's Games. Each match asks you to place and upgrade a team of units, hold the lane against escalating waves, and earn Coins that fund summons, upgrades, and a stronger lineup.

Progress comes from smart economy and placement rather than lucky pulls alone. Build a carry around control, support, and income roles, test new units on easier modes, and use the weekly update cycle to adjust your team before pushing higher difficulties or the leaderboard.

items.question: What is Alliance Tower Defense?
items.answer: Alliance Tower Defense is a Roblox tower defense strategy game from MrUpTime's Games. You place and upgrade units, survive waves, earn Coins, summon new units, build a team, and push the leaderboard across weekly updates.

items.question: How do Alliance Tower Defense codes work?
items.answer: Alliance Tower Defense codes grant free Coins when entered exactly as written. Open the Shop, paste the code into the text box at the bottom, and redeem one code at a time. The Halloween and 10M codes are active for October 2026.

items.question: What should I do first in Alliance Tower Defense?
items.answer: Start with cheap damage coverage at the first turn, add splash for groups, and keep a small Coin reserve. Upgrade your main damage before spreading resources across new units.

items.question: How should I spend summons in Alliance Tower Defense?
items.answer: Use stage clears, daily tasks, and events to build summon currency. Pull for a specific role your team lacks, and value duplicates because they drive star-ups, awakening, and trait improvements.

items.question: Why is Medium mode hard in Alliance Tower Defense?
items.answer: Medium mode is the first major difficulty wall in Alliance Tower Defense. Bank Coins before summoning, test new units on Easy, prioritize placement over rarity, and check the leaderboard for the current team shape.

items.question: How often does Alliance Tower Defense update?
items.answer: Alliance Tower Defense follows a weekly update schedule. New units, banners, events, and balance changes can shift which summons and teams are worth building.
